permWarning.title: Limited permissions.
permWarning.body: This account cannot read user profiles in BioStar 2, so the group, email, department, telephone and login ID tags fall back to the raw event data. Grant the account the Users read permission in BioStar 2 to enable them.

eventTypes.label: Event types seen
eventTypes.hint: Every event name BioStar 2 has sent since the app started, most frequent first. Tick one to drop it before any processing — that is what keeps the app idle when nothing relevant is happening. Ticked rows never reach your Flows.
eventTypes.empty: No events seen yet. They appear here as BioStar 2 sends them.
eventTypes.manualPlaceholder: Add an event name not listed yet

ignoreSubstrings.label: Ignored event names (contains)
ignoreSubstrings.hint: One per line. Any event whose name contains one of these fragments is dropped.

logUserNames.label: Show user names in the activity log
logUserNames.hint: On by default, because names are what make the log useful when a Flow misbehaves. Turn it off to keep identifiable access data out of the log view — entries then read "User: <hidden>". This only affects the log; Flow tags always carry the real user, and the log is in-memory only and cleared when the app restarts.

clock.label: Always use a 24-hour clock in the activity log
clock.hint: Off by default: the clock follows Homey's language — 24 hours for Dutch and French, 12 hours with AM/PM for English. Tick this to use 24 hours whatever the language. Entries already in the log keep the format they were written with.

persistLogs.label: Also keep the activity log on Homey's storage
persistLogs.hint: Off by default. The log normally lives in memory only and is lost whenever the app restarts. Turn this on to write it to Homey's internal storage as well, so it survives a restart. At most 256 KB is kept and the oldest entries are dropped first; writes are batched so the flash memory is not worn down. Turning it off again deletes the stored file. Consider that this puts access-control history on disk.

timing.heartbeatHint: How often the app pings BioStar 2. The connection is considered dead after twice this long without a reply.
timing.reconnectHint: The delay grows by 50% after each failed attempt, up to this ceiling.
